display_long_description:
Welcome to ShivLok, your personal gateway into a silent cavern temple devoted to Lord Shiva, now on Meta Quest! Slip on your headset and stand on a floating stone platform. Ahead, a glowing golden mural of Shiva’s serene face beckons you inward.

Explore & Interact
Climb moss-covered steps to an ornate archway, ring the hanging bell, and feel its deep resonance fill the chamber. At the heart of the grotto, approach the carved Shiva Linga to light oil lamps, place flower petals, or pour vessels of water and milk—each action paired with subtle audio cues for a truly sacred offering.

Immersive Soundscape & Atmosphere
A single, masterfully mixed track blends soothing chant, and flowing water into an uninterrupted backdrop. Flickering torches and natural cavern echoes deepen your sense of presence—no menus or spoken prompts, just pure, meditative stillness.

Download ShivLok today and lose yourself in the timeless chant and tranquil wonder of Lord Shiva’s sacred realm.
